qa_pairs.question: What information does the "Cloud statistics" section provide to Alliance users?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Cloud statistics" section displays a table of all virtual machines associated with your account, including their type (Flavor) and a unique identifier (UUID).

qa_pairs.question: What types of usage statistics are available for individual virtual machines in the "Cloud statistics" section?
qa_pairs.answer: Each virtual machine has its own usage statistics, including CPU cores, memory, disk bandwidth, IOPS, and network bandwidth.

qa_pairs.question: For what time periods can users view the usage statistics for their virtual machines under "Cloud statistics"?
qa_pairs.answer: Virtual machine usage statistics can be shown for the last month, week, day, or hour.
